description: SDLC gate enforcement hooks for Capstone Item Manager. Injects persistent stage-governance context, blocks unsafe auto-advancement intent, and reinforces evidence-first gate behavior.

SessionStart.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Capstone SDLC Pipeline active. Gate approval is REQUIRED before each stage transition. Never skip gates."}'
SessionStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$artifacts = @('requirements.md','architecture.md','design-review.md','impl-plan.md','verification-report.md','CHANGELOG.md','sdlc-report.html') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }; $msg = if ($artifacts) { $artifacts -join ', ' } else { 'none' }; $state = if (Test-Path '/memories/session/sdlc-gate-state.md') { 'present' } else { 'missing' }; Write-Output ('{\"systemMessage\": \"Capstone SDLC pipeline active. Existing artifacts: ' + $msg + '. Session gate-state file: ' + $state + '. Approval is mandatory before stage transitions. Do not skip stages, do not auto-advance, and do not fabricate evidence.\"}')"

PreToolUse.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$tool = $env:COPILOT_TOOL_NAME; $msg = $env:COPILOT_TOOL_INPUT; if (-not $tool) { Write-Output '{\"continue\": true}'; exit 0 }; $lower = ($msg + '').ToLowerInvariant(); if ($lower -match 'auto-advance|skip gate|bypass gate|force pass') { Write-Output '{\"continue\": true, \"systemMessage\": \"Reminder: SDLC gate bypass intent detected in tool context. Continue only with evidence-backed, stage-scoped actions and explicit approval boundaries.\"}'; } else { Write-Output '{\"continue\": true}'; }"

SubagentStart.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Subagent starting for Capstone SDLC. Follow stage scope, gather objective evidence, output gate decision, and STOP."}'
SubagentStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent starting for Capstone SDLC. Follow stage scope, gather objective evidence, output gate decision, and STOP for human approval.\"}'"

SubagentStop.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Subagent complete. Publish PASS/FAIL with evidence and wait for explicit approval before any stage transition."}'
SubagentStop.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent complete. Publish PASS/FAIL with evidence and wait for explicit approval before any stage transition.\"}'"
